title: From vague request to paid, trusted analysis

say: From a vague request to a paid, trusted analysis.
This is the video for module 3 of SQL Fundamentals: Analysis Projects, Clients and Your Portfolio.
A manager says, send me our best customers. If you start typing straight away, you answer your own guess, not her question. So ask first.

panel.heading: Ask before you type any SQL
items: What decision will this support?
How do you define the key word?
Which period?
What should be excluded?
What format, by when, and how often?

say: A CTE, a common table expression, lets you name one step with WITH, then use it like a table. Kemi's first step, called spend, totals delivered orders per customer.

panel.heading: Best customers, built step by step
items: WITH spend AS: delivered total per customer
Check: 5 customers, adding to 211,500
Average per buying customer: 42,300
Keep those above it: Dupe, Amaka, Bisi

say: Window functions calculate across rows while keeping every row. SUM OVER gives a running total. LAG brings the value from the previous row, so you can see the change.

say: Beginners price only the time to type the final query. Real work takes longer. Halima estimates every stage: discovery and scope, 2 hours. Access and loading, 3. Writing and testing queries, 5. Checks, 2. The report, 3.
That is 15 hours. She adds a 20 percent buffer, 3 hours, for 18 in total.

card.title: Halima quotes a sales analysis
card.note: 5,000 an hour is for the method only, not a market rate.

say: At an illustrative 5,000 naira an hour, that is 90,000 naira. Research your own rate.

say: Sales data holds personal data, and the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 sets rules for it. So ask for read-only access. Before any command that changes data, first run the same WHERE condition in a SELECT.

panel.heading: Safe data habits for analysts

cards.d: You cannot change or delete records by mistake. DELETE, UPDATE and DROP often have no undo.
Request minimum columns. Replace names with IDs. No exports in personal WhatsApp chats.
Store files with two-step verification, delete them after the job, and confirm in writing.

say: Ask only for the columns you need. You rarely need phone numbers to count sales. Never send exports through personal WhatsApp chats or public tools.

say: Certificates say you studied. A portfolio shows you can do the work. Take one public dataset, from Kaggle or World Bank Open Data, and write 3 to 5 questions a manager would ask.

panel.heading: A portfolio project that gets noticed
items: 3 to 5 business questions as definitions
One query each, up to a CTE and a window
Record your checks and what they caught
Plain-language findings with one or two charts
Publish on GitHub and pin it to LinkedIn

say: To remember. Agree the definition before you query. Build in named, checked steps. Price every stage of the work, not just the final query. And treat client data with care from access to deletion.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Agree a one-sentence definition first
Name each step with a CTE and check it
Window functions keep every row
Scope, estimate every stage, take a deposit
Read-only access, minimum data, delete at end
